A jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-jev-adapter"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Use the **Jev (System One) decision-model paradigm with any OpenAI-compatible LLM** — no TypeSafe AP"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"I key required. Registers a `jev_decide` tool on DeepSeek Harness (dsh)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Jev (TypeSafe AI) is a decision model: you send a state plus typed questions (choice / score / boole"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"an), it returns calibrated, probability-distributed answers — no text generation. This plugin brings"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" that **paradigm** to any chat model you already have, and can also talk to the real Jev API if you "},{"id":"p5s4","text":"adigm** to any chat model you already have, and can also talk to the real Jev API if you have a key."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- `zhangxaochen/dsh-jev` (worth checking out) integrates the **official** TypeSafe API — great if yo"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"u have a key and can reach `api.typesafe.ai`.
- This plugin covers everyone else: **any OpenAI-compa"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"tible endpoint works** — DeepSeek's own API, Ollama, vLLM, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, LM Studio, or an"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" air-gapped internal gateway.
- Probabilities on the `openai` channel are the model's self-reported "},{"id":"p7s5","text":"estimates (not mathematically calibrated — every result carries this caveat). On the `typesafe` chan"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"nel you get the real thing."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"One tool, `jev_decide`, callable by the agent:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Question type | You provide | You get back |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| `choice` | options map (≤255) | picked option + full probability distribution + confidence |
| `sc"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ore` | ordered levels (2–10) | fractional score + per-level probabilities + confidence |
| `boolean`"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" | a statement | P(true) |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Ask many questions in one call — 1 and 10 questions cost about the same."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then set one environment variable and restart dsh:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Or configure in `cordis.patch.yml` instead of env vars (see below)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"All settings live in the plugin row in `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Just talk to your agent — it decides when to call the tool:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The agent sends all judgements as typed questions in one `jev_decide` call and gets back a table of "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"s all judgements as typed questions in one `jev_decide` call and gets back a table of probabilities."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Routing on confidence** (the whole point of the paradigm):"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Tune thresholds to the risk of the action, and remember the caveat: on the `openai` channel these ar"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"e self-reported probabilities, not calibrated ones."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Details worth knowing"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Honesty prompt.** The adapter explicitly instructs the model to spread probability when uncertai"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"n instead of forcing a fake 1.0 — without this, confidence saturates and the routing signal is lost "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"(validated on real Chinese-language work items; see the prompt in `lib/adapter.js`).
- **Thinking mo"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"dels.** Models that leave `content` empty and answer in `reasoning_content` are handled.
- **Normali"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"sation.** Probabilities that don't sum to 1 are renormalised; an all-zero answer degrades to uniform"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" rather than failing.
- **Retries.** 429/5xx retried with exponential backoff (default 3 attempts)."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Relation to other Jev plugins"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| | `zhangxaochen/dsh-jev` | this plugin |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Real TypeSafe Jev | ✅ | ✅ (`typesafe` channel) |
| Any OpenAI-compatible LLM | ❌ | ✅ (default) |
|"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" Tool pruning / loop guard / safety gate | ✅ | ❌ (different scope) |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"They are complementary: pick his for the guard suite with a real Jev key, this one for the decision "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"paradigm on any model."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"# dsh-jev-adapter（中文）"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"把 **Jev（System One）决策模型范式套在任何 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 上**——不需要 TypeSafe API key。在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 上注册一"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"）决策模型范式套在任何 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 上**——不需要 TypeSafe API key。在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 上注册一个 `jev_decide` 工具。"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Jev（TypeSafe AI）是决策模型：发一段状态加一组类型化问题（choice / score / boolean），返回带概率分布的结构化答案——不生成文字。本插件把这个**范式**带到你已有"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"的任意聊天模型上；如果你有 key，也可以直连真 Jev。"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## 为什么做这个"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"- `zhangxaochen/dsh-jev`（推荐一看）对接的是 **官方** TypeSafe API——有 key 且能访问 `api.typesafe.ai` 时很好。
- 本插件覆盖其他人"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"：**任何 OpenAI 兼容端点都能跑**——DeepSeek 官方 API、Ollama、vLLM、OpenRouter、硅基流动、LM Studio、或内网网关。
- `openai` 通道的概"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"率是模型自述的估计值（非数学校准，每个结果都带此提示）；`typesafe` 通道给你真货。"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## 你得到什么"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"一个工具 `jev_decide`，Agent 可直接调用："},{"id":"p43s1","text":"| 问题类型 | 你提供 | 返回 |"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"| `choice` | 选项映射（≤255 项） | 选中的选项 + 完整概率分布 + 置信度 |
| `score` | 有序等级（2–10 级） | 分数 + 各等级概率 + 置信度 |
| `"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"boolean` | 一个陈述 | P(为真) |"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"一次调用可以并行问多个问题——问 1 个和问 10 个代价几乎一样。"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"设一个环境变量后重启 dsh："},{"id":"p49s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p50s1","text":"也可以在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里配置（见英文节的 Configure）。"},{"id":"p51s1","text":"## 使用"},{"id":"p52s1","text":"直接跟 Agent 说话，它自己决定何时调用："},{"id":"p53s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p54s1","text":"Agent 会把所有判断作为类型化问题放进一次 `jev_decide` 调用，拿到一张概率表。"},{"id":"p55s1","text":"**按置信度路由**（这套范式的意义所在）："},{"id":"p56s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p57s1","text":"阈值按操作风险调；记住提示：`openai` 通道的概率是自述值，不是校准值。"},{"id":"p58s1","text":"## 值得知道的细节"},{"id":"p59s1","text":"- **诚实性提示词**。适配器明确要求模型不确定时如实分散概率、不要硬给 1.0——没有这条，置信度会饱和，路由信号失效（在真实中文工作事项上验证过，见 `lib/adapter.js`）。
- *"},{"id":"p59s2","text":"*思考模型兼容**。`content` 为空、答案在 `reasoning_content` 的模型已处理。
- **归一化**。概率之和不为 1 时重新归一化；全零答案退化为均匀分布而不是报错。
-"},{"id":"p59s3","text":" **重试**。429/5xx 指数退避重试（默认 3 次）。"},{"id":"p60s1","text":"## 与其他 Jev 插件的关系"},{"id":"p61s1","text":"| | `zhangxaochen/dsh-jev` | 本插件 |"},{"id":"p62s1","text":"| 真 TypeSafe Jev | ✅ | ✅（`typesafe` 通道） |
